svg.title: Latest comparisons · native/universal performance matrix
svg.text: One matrix: same-flavor weighted/full-workload scores and per-case results, plus latest native vs universal. Scores below 100.000p favor the candidate.
Case cells emphasize candidate/reference points; hover a score for both p50 timings. Blue is faster; red is slower.
